report.transition: Phase 6 — internalizing the energy budget: where an internal store beats leakage + maintenance, per coupling class

feasibility.admissibility: grid points (activity x permeability x pmf) where the class and the passive baseline ran with the free-energy ledger closed; 'pays' = settled net power exceeds the passive baseline's at the same membrane and gradient by > 1e-21 W

robustness.binding_observation: Lost City vent-ocean pH gradient (vg-data energy_currencies; external_pmf calibrated to the Phase-1 posterior)
robustness.note: fraction of the swept grid (uniform in activity, log in permeability, two gradient states; NOT a conditioned posterior) where internalization pays; structure_agreement = fraction of the grid on which every active class gives the same pays / does-not-pay answer

proposed_perturbations: tighten the membrane (lower P_H by 100x, e.g. mixed amphiphiles + divalent cations): the ion-gradient class predicts its store potential rises to the load and internalization starts to pay, the chemical carriers barely change — the leak law separates them
lower the load (a 20 kJ/mol step): the polyphosphate class predicts a threshold appears, the thioester class predicts a lower threshold activity

collapse the external gradient (og-05): every active class predicts autonomy -> 1 and the passive baseline falls to -maintenance; the surviving net power ranks the classes by their leak-independent store
discrimination.note: paired standardised difference d between model classes on identical grid points

report.headline: Phase 6 — internalizing the energy budget: where an internal store beats leakage + maintenance, per coupling class: demonstrates in a coarse-grained model; feasible=yes (150/792 admissible parameterizations support it); robustness=0.54 of the posterior (agreement across classes 0.46); most discriminating readout: store_potential (d=1.93)

headline: h_na_gradient_leaky_membrane: never pays at the nominal membrane (ceiling 1e-08 m/s); thioester_acyl_phosphate: pays from activity 0.10 (autonomy 0.03, best +2.1e-18 W at 0.80); polyphosphate: never pays at the nominal membrane (ceiling None m/s); fe_redox: pays from activity 0.80 (autonomy 0.17, best +1.8e-19 W at 1.00); cross-class agreement on 'pays' 0.46
